h1: Unleashing Imaginative Play: FunPlay's Design Process Unveiled

props.title: Unleashing Imaginative Play: FunPlay's Design Process Unveiled
props.summaryText: How a FunPlay design goes from watching children play to a finished product: observation, sketches, CAD engineering, safety review and renderings.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: FunPlay team working together on a playground project

takeaways.text: Our designs start with watching and talking to children, not with a catalogue.
Ideas are sketched, refined and engineered in CAD with safety and manufacturing in mind.
3D renderings let the team and clients judge the look and play value before production.
The same process is used for standard ranges and custom designs.

faq.q: How does FunPlay design playground equipment?
faq.a: We observe children at play and talk to them, brainstorm and sketch ideas, refine the strongest concepts, engineer them in CAD with safety standards and manufacturing in mind, create 3D renderings to review look and play value, then prototype and produce.

faq.q: Can FunPlay design a custom playground?
faq.a: Yes. Our design team can adapt standard designs or develop new ones for a specific site, theme or brand. Custom designs take longer because of design development and approvals.
Our design team won a Red Dot Design Award in 2024.
